# Klare

> Klare (klareai.com) is an AI study tool for university students that transforms bad lecture recordings into structured, readable study documents. It re-teaches concepts from scratch using a personal-tutor approach — not a summariser, not a note-taker.

## What Klare does

Klare takes a lecture audio, video, PDF slides, or transcript from a university course and generates a clear, textbook-verified study document. The professor's explanation is discarded entirely — Klare teaches each concept fresh using concrete examples before introducing formal terminology, calibrated to the student's year level and program.

A second AI then cross-checks the generated output against the original lecture and patches any missed content automatically.

## Who it's for

- Medical students
- Biomedical science students
- Nursing and health science students
- Pharmacy and pharmacology students
- Any university student whose professor explains things poorly

## Key differentiator

Unlike AI note-takers (Otter.ai, NotebookLM, Studley, Turbo AI) that summarise or clean up the professor's words, Klare identifies what concepts the lecture covers and re-teaches them from scratch — the way the best human tutor would. If your professor explains things badly, Klare fixes that at the root.

## Accuracy

Every claim in a Klare document is verified against OpenStax, NCBI, or PubMed during generation. Klare also corrects transcript errors (misspellings, muffled terms) against known textbook terminology.

## Pricing (AUD)

- Free tier: 1 lecture, no credit card required
- Pro and Max: paid plans billed monthly or yearly in AUD
- Contact: hello@klareai.com

## Comparisons

- Klare vs NotebookLM: NotebookLM organises what the professor said. Klare throws out the professor's explanation and teaches the concept properly.
- Klare vs Otter.ai: Otter.ai is a transcription tool. Klare re-teaches the content.
- Klare vs Studley / Turbo AI: those tools compress the professor's words into cleaner notes. Klare asks "was this explained well?" and starts over if not.
